title: Editor’s pick: Dispatch Biotherapeutics - Nature Biotechnology
text:
Each year, Nature Biotechnology highlights companies that received sizeable early-stage funding in the previous year. Dispatch Bio delivers antigens to solid tumors for CAR T immunotherapy.
